title: Dell's AI servers pick up the slack as PC sales slump
hook: 你看見一條繩子，左邊那端軟趴趴地垂在地上。
bridge: 繩子旁邊，一根長條像洩了氣一樣，一路往下沉。
p: CNBC reported that Dell's sales more than doubled in its latest quarter, to $54.94 billion. Servers built for AI brought in $22 billion, and Dell said it holds a $132.3 billion backlog of AI server orders. Those machines {0} on the PC side, where laptop revenue came in below what analysts had expected.

Dell's PC business was hurt by a market CNBC said was in a {1}, as rising memory prices made devices costlier and shoppers kept their old laptops. Vice chairman Jeff Clarke said Dell is now a different company, with its server unit driving most of its profit and growth.

words.zh: 接手別人做不完的部分
words.def: to do the work that someone else is not doing or cannot do
words.mn: Dell 的 PC 那端繩子鬆垮垮垂在地上，AI 伺服器那端的手一把拉緊，把黃色箱子拖過來。鬆掉的繩子（slack）被拉起來，就是接手空缺。
words.ex: Two engineers quit, so the rest of us had to pick up the slack.
words.exZh: 兩位工程師離職，剩下的人只好接手他們的工作。

words.def: a sudden or long drop in sales, prices or performance
words.mn: Dell 的 PC 長條像人癱坐在椅子上，整個人一路往下滑，越坐越矮。身體癱軟下沉，就是銷量低迷。
words.ex: Home sales are in a slump because mortgage rates are so high.
words.exZh: 房貸利率太高，房屋銷售陷入低迷。

quiz.q: When our teammate went on leave, Maria had to ___ on the launch.
quiz.why: pick up the slack 是接手別人沒做完的工作。cut some slack 是對人寬容、放一馬，slack off 是偷懶。

quiz.q: The company's profits fell during the summer ___ in tourism.
quiz.why: slump 是銷量或業績低迷。surge 是暴增，outlook 是展望，放進句子都不符合『下滑』的意思。
